waive.TypeOK: Shape/bounds hygiene, not a behavioral promise; no useful well-typed protocol mutation isolates it.

mutations.name: notify-under-held-gates
mutations.why: Notify the reentrant observer synchronously before releasing the retiring operation's gates.

mutations.name: notify-under-held-gates-deadlock
mutations.why: A synchronous observer waits for the emitter's native gate while the emitter waits for the observer.

mutations.name: invalidate-after-unlock-stale-worker
mutations.why: Release the old document gate before logical retirement, allowing an old-document-only worker effect after the swap.

mutations.name: invalidate-after-unlock-nonatomic-publication
mutations.why: Publish the new attachment while the old document is still logically live.

mutations.name: alias-reacquire
mutations.why: Acquire the same source/destination native gate twice instead of deduplicating aliases.

mutations.name: alias-reacquire-deadlock
mutations.why: The second acquisition waits on the non-reentrant gate held by the same retiring operation.

mutations.name: drop-deferred-notification
mutations.why: Consume each deferred per-document notification without delivering any callback wakeup after unlocking.

mutations.name: drop-only-second-document-notification
mutations.why: Deliver document one's callback but silently discard only document two's notification; aggregate wakeup checks would miss this.
